A1_internal_forces_sum_to_zero.detail: translation-invariant pair forces obey Newton's third law

A4_minimal_coupling_internal_E_free.detail: gamma_i=m_i: every internal acceleration is E-independent for arbitrary pair potentials (nonlinear, all orders)

B2_kinetic_split.detail: sum p^2/2m = P^2/2M + sum pi^2/2m (momenta commute)

B3_uniform_coupling_is_COM_only.detail: -E sum m_a x_a = -E M R (gravitational = inertial weights)

C1_GP_Avron_Herbst_covariance.detail: residual_E = phase * residual_0(x - xi, t) with S' = m|xi'|^2/2; E(t)=xi'' arbitrary (time-dependent uniform field)

C2_Euler_continuity_covariance.detail: barotropic baryon fluid (any P(rho), incl. K_b rho^(5/3)): residuals map exactly; v_E = v_0 + xi'

C3_Poisson_translation.detail: (trivial identity) Laplacian is translation invariant and m|psi|^2+rho_b translate rigidly: one-copy Poisson maps to itself

D1_closed_chain_zero_internal_response.detail: k3=0: internal extensions vanish identically at every omega>0 and every m_s; displacement = -E/omega^2 common to all bodies

D3_anchored_static_sag.detail: omega=0, any k3>0: c-h extension m_c E/k1, h-s extension (m_c+m_h)E/k2, anchor carries the total weight (support displacement M_tot E/k3)

D6_closed_chain_exact_trajectory.detail: x_i(t)=x_i(0)+E t^2/2 solves the closed chain exactly from a relaxed state: no transient internal motion at any E

E2_tidal_tensor_invariant.detail: d_i d_j U' = d_i d_j U

E3_support_acceleration_invariant.detail: (x'' - g) is invariant: the only local scalar equal to |g| is |f/rho| of NON-geodesic (supported) matter
